method: Original decision-log entry and measurements are preserved verbatim below.
finding: basic-memory MCP server, context cost measured (test type: static count from the pinned wheel, no server started, n=1). `basic-memory==1.0.0` (PyPI wheel, 1.8 MB, downloaded and unpacked, not run) registers 13 `@mcp.tool` functions under `basic_memory/mcp`: `bm_write`, `bm_read`, `bm_edit`, `bm_move`, `bm_delete`, `bm_search`, `bm_find`, `bm_list`, `bm_context`, `bm_schema`, `bm_project`,…

rows: - 17 Nov, basic-memory MCP server, context cost measured (test type: static count from the pinned wheel, no server started, n=1). `basic-memory==1.0.0` (PyPI wheel, 1.8 MB, downloaded and unpacked, not run) registers 13 `@mcp.tool` functions under `basic_memory/mcp`: `bm_write`, `bm_read`, `bm_edit`, `bm_move`, `bm_delete`, `bm_search`, `bm_find`, `bm_list`, `bm_context`, `bm_schema`, `bm_project`, `bm_project_delete`, `bm_man`. Name, docstring and signature text add up to about 12.8 KB (largest `bm_search` 2.4 KB, `bm_write` 1.7 KB, `bm_edit` 1.6 KB), roughly 3.2 k tokens at 4 bytes per token before the JSON-schema wrapping, so expect 4 to 5 k tokens of tool definitions in every session that launches it. Enabled flags: `default` and `opencode` tiers `enabled: false` (no cost there); `claude` and `codex` have no flag in the contract, so both pay the cost on every session. Not measured: the live `tools/list` payload and whether the package honours the three env variables. Decision: keep registered, but the unconditional Claude and Codex cost is the open point; no benefit has been measured, so enable nothing further until a `wf rca ask --stats` / `--savings` run shows memory lookups pay for about 4 k tokens per session.
